documents.title: Agreement between the Polish Republic and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics concerning the exchange of sectors of their State territories
documents.publicationCitation: United Nations Treaty Series, Vol. 432, No. 6222, pp. 199 ff.
documents.notes: Article 1 and Article 2 exchange two 480 km² sectors and amend the state frontier. UNTS records entry into force on 5 June 1951 by exchange of ratifications. Used here to bound the preceding verified USSR legal-border state through May 1951; the post-exchange geometry remains a separate reconstruction task.
